MOIDS.zip.meaning: Dates are parsed from actual acquisition columns across supplied members. An absent positive-record date is not verified zero, a missing swath or proof of a missing physical file. The comparison span is the union of supplied daily-ZIP dates, not an assumed delivery contract.
